description: This Java source file defines the class ConfigXMLReader, which is responsible for reading, parsing, and managing configuration data from XML files related to web application controllers within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for representing controller configurations, events, request mappings, response handling, and view mappings, facilitating dynamic and flexible control flow configuration.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader
classes.description: Main class responsible for reading, parsing, and managing web app controller XML config files, including nested classes for controller configuration details, events, request mappings, response handling, and view mappings.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ControllerConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for a particular web controller, including its URL, request mappings, view mappings, event handlers, includes, and various configuration properties loaded from the XML.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.Event
classes.description: Encapsulates an event configuration within a controller request, including type, path, invoke method, transaction management, and optional metrics.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestMap
classes.description: Defines a request mapping, including URI, HTTP method, security requirements, associated event, and responses.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponse
classes.description: Represents a response configuration for a request, including response type, value, status code, redirect parameters, and associated user message.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.RequestResponseUserMessage
classes.description: Contains user message details for a response, including resource, value, and originating form-field.

classes.name: ConfigXMLReader.ViewMap
classes.description: Represents a view mapping configuration, including page, content type, encoding, security options, and cache directives.

methods.name: getEmptyNoneRequestResponse
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty RequestResponse with 'none' type.

methods.name: findControllerFilesWithRequest
methods.description: Retrieves controller file URLs that contain specific request URIs, utilizing an internal cache for performance.

methods.name: findControllerRequestUniqueForTargetType
methods.description: Finds unique controller request identifiers linked to a given target and URL mode ('intra-app' or 'inter-app').

methods.name: getControllerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the ControllerConfig object for a given WebappInfo or URL, loading and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: getControllerConfigURL
methods.description: Gets the URL of the controller configuration XML file from a ServletContext.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML document from a given URL, returning the root element.
